---
name: Policy or implementation bug
description: Report a validator, schema, CLI, hook, adapter, or documentation inconsistency
title: "[bug] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Affected component

Identify the command, schema, invariant, gate, hook, adapter, workflow, or document.

## Expected behavior

Cite the controlling specification or policy rule.

## Actual behavior

Provide output, error text, or the invalid state that was accepted or valid state that was rejected.

## Minimal reproduction

Include commit SHA, environment, commands, and the smallest fixture or repository state that reproduces the problem.

## Impact

Could this permit an invalid claim transition, false conformance, evidence loss, unsafe mutation, or release inconsistency?
